Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4203, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

I read the complete diff and issue #3909. I checked the guide claims against the current implementation.
The eight entries have guide coverage. The remaining umbrella work stays open, so `Refs #3909` is correct.
The decision record, scope, and verification notes are complete.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4203`, with no GitHub runner.
The trial merge is `6abf0b42663cc1524816213ed4972d85d289fb42`.
Its first parent is the PR head. Its second parent is upstream/main `7b2587e150e1c1ee9719d065d18f390e337f0ad1`.
I used that main revision's AGENTS.md for the law checks.

Results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: exit 0; zero applicable Rust steps.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: six steps passed, including the release build; zero failed or stalled.
- Light tests: motion lib 7 passed; adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, and app pocket_pass_start each passed 1.
- Zola 0.23.6 site build: passed. The navigation tests also built the site with a deployment prefix.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

Extra suites run:

- Focused site suite: 65 tests passed. Modules: test_release_027_batch3, test_guide_navigation, test_guide_after_1995, test_guide_refresh, test_operation_reference, test_release_026_gaps, test_release_026_guide, test_release_022_guide, and test_guide_images.
- `ZOLA=<zola-0.23.6> python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 112 tests, three failures.
- I ran the same discovery command on bare upstream/main: 104 tests, the same three failures.

The pre-existing failures are:

```text
test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app:
  op-rotary-contour.png in site/static/icons/ drifted from assets/ui/
  op-rotary-parallel.png in site/static/icons/ drifted from assets/ui/
test_manifest_properties_have_reference_rows:
  Missing manifest reference rows: ['manualToolChange']
```

These failures do not block this PR. No new site failure remains.

Requested before merge: none.

Safety mutations and moved-golden checks do not apply. This PR changes documentation and site tests only.
It changes no UI code, test fixtures, importers, generated programs, or CAM implementation.
Application catalog suites, importer suites, full heavy lanes, and clippy were not run for this documentation diff.

Identity note: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is unset. This direct Codex session uses review-4203 as its task identifier.
The review worktree, branch, and build output remain in place for reuse. No review evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
